ai_summary: Bajel Projects Limited has secured a significant "Major Order" EPC contract, valued between Rs. 200 Cr and Rs. 300 Cr, from The Tata Power Company Limited for the supply and installation of 220 kV GIS substations in Mumbai. This 18-month project is in the ordinary course of business, expected to materially boost the company's revenue and strengthen its position in power infrastructure. No red flags are apparent, as the company explicitly confirmed it is not a related party transaction and there is no promoter interest in the awarding entity.
